specification.outcome: A user can create an ordinary Backlog task or replace an existing Backlog task's canonical specification through normal conversation, without a campaign and without implicitly beginning work.

scenarios.name: create an ordinary unspecified backlog task
given: create-task contains a title and description accepted by parseTaskTitle and parseTaskDescription and omits specification
the verified signed board is writable
when: the host evaluates the normal-language request
then: it journals the request digest plus stable generated task and event IDs before publication
it publishes one signed task-created event and returns TIBER_TASK_CREATED with task ID, event ID, resulting board head, disposition, and specificationDigest {kind:none}
the projected task is unclaimed and unspecified in Backlog without campaign provenance

scenarios.name: atomically create a specified backlog task
given: create-task contains valid task metadata and a complete value accepted by parseTaskSpecification
the verified signed board is writable
then: it publishes one signed task-created-and-specified compound event containing metadata, canonical specification, and digest
foldTaskEvents projects the task and specification atomically from that single event
signing, push, parse, or projection failure exposes neither a partial task nor a partial specification

scenarios.name: amend only an existing backlog specification
given: specify-task contains an exact UUID task ID and a complete replacement accepted by parseTaskSpecification
the target exists unclaimed in Backlog
the host binds the verified board head and current Option specification digest
then: one task-specified event replaces only specification and digest
identity, title, description, Backlog state, claim state, ordering, priority, and campaign provenance are preserved
success returns TIBER_TASK_SPECIFIED with task ID, event ID, resulting board head, published disposition, and resulting digest

scenarios.name: return an idempotent no-op for an unchanged specification
given: the replacement canonical digest equals the current specification digest
then: no event or Git commit is published
success returns TIBER_TASK_SPECIFICATION_UNCHANGED with task ID, current board head, unchanged disposition, and current digest

scenarios.name: reject invalid create requests in deterministic order
given: one or more create-task preconditions are invalid
when: the host evaluates available facts in order and stops at the first failure
then: precedence is TIBER_WORKFLOW_REQUEST_INVALID for malformed request shape, TIBER_SPECIFICATION_INVALID for a supplied complete-shape but semantically invalid specification, TIBER_TASK_BOARD_READ_ONLY, TIBER_TASK_ID_COLLISION after bounded pre-publication regeneration, TIBER_TASK_PUBLICATION_UNAUTHORIZED for signer or publication authorization failure, then TIBER_TASK_PUBLICATION_CONFLICT
no task, campaign, readiness, claim, run, or worktree event occurs

scenarios.name: reject invalid specification amendments in deterministic order
given: one or more specify-task preconditions are invalid
when: the host evaluates available facts in order and stops at the first failure
then: precedence is TIBER_WORKFLOW_REQUEST_INVALID, TIBER_TASK_ID_INVALID for a non-UUID or unresolved ambiguous reference, TIBER_SPECIFICATION_INVALID, TIBER_TASK_BOARD_READ_ONLY, TIBER_TASK_NOT_FOUND, TIBER_TASK_LIFECYCLE_INVALID, TIBER_TASK_PUBLICATION_UNAUTHORIZED, then TIBER_TASK_PUBLICATION_CONFLICT
no task, campaign, readiness, claim, run, or worktree event occurs

scenarios.name: handle concurrent publication without overwriting authority
given: the host has journaled stable IDs and bound an observed board head plus target Option digest
when: fast-forward publication observes a newer remote head
then: an unrelated-head advance is retried automatically with the same request digest and identifiers only when task absence for create or target lifecycle and Option digest for amend remain unchanged
a same-task specification or lifecycle change returns TIBER_TASK_PUBLICATION_CONFLICT and requires a newly evaluated user request
a stale replacement never overwrites newer task state

scenarios.name: reconcile a lost publication receipt idempotently
given: publication succeeded but the local success receipt was not recorded
then: the host observes the exact task ID, event ID, request digest, and canonical content on the signed board and returns the success receipt with reconciled disposition
matching authority is not republished and a mismatched identifier or content returns TIBER_TASK_PUBLICATION_CONFLICT
generated identifiers remain stable across every safe retry and reconciliation

scenarios.name: route ordinary language independently of campaigns
given: the user asks to create a ticket or replace a Backlog specification
no campaign exists or an unrelated campaign is active
then: the closed request is create-task or specify-task rather than campaign-goal or begin-task
campaign state is neither required nor changed and no readiness review or claim begins

acceptanceCriteria: Specified creation uses exactly one task-created-and-specified event whose signature and ancestry are verified like every other event in the signed publication commit; projection either installs metadata plus specification together or rejects the event.

create-task accepts title, description, and optional complete TaskSpecification. An omitted specification means Option none; a supplied partial or semantically invalid value is denied and never treated as unspecified.

specify-task accepts only an exact TaskId UUID. Inference must resolve conversational references to one signed task ID before requesting the effect; unresolved or ambiguous references are denied as TIBER_TASK_ID_INVALID.

Specifications are parsed once into existing semantic values. digestTaskSpecification remains sha256: plus lowercase SHA-256 of JSON.stringify of the host-canonical parsed object. Absence is Option {kind:none}, never a sentinel hash.
The host journals operation kind, canonical request digest, generated task/event IDs, observed board head, and expected Option digest before effects, enabling idempotent lost-receipt reconciliation.
Automatic retry is allowed only for unrelated head advancement with unchanged target preconditions. Lifecycle or specification changes require renewed user evaluation.

Public success receipts contain code, disposition published|unchanged|reconciled, taskId, resulting full boardHead, specificationDigest Option, and eventId Option. Public denials contain the stable code and safe operation/task context without capability material.
Ordinary operations do not promote, prioritize, review, claim, start, create campaign provenance, or alter campaign checkpoints.
exclusions: Changing title or description after creation
Automatically starting, reviewing, ranking, or claiming tasks
Changing campaign scheduling or goal semantics
Weakening signature, ancestry, or lifecycle verification
dependencies: src/core/tasks/task-values.ts semantic metadata and identity parsers
src/core/tasks/readiness.ts canonical specification parser and digest
src/core/tasks/task-board.ts signed event schema and projection
src/adapters/tasks/git-task-remote.ts signer, verified-head observation, and fast-forward publisher
src/extension/workflow-request-tool.ts deterministic dispatcher and operation journal
Task Backlog lifecycle and exclusive-claim invariants
specification.architectureImplications: Extend the closed workflow request algebra and host dispatcher with create-task and specify-task. Add one atomic task-created-and-specified authority event. The host owns parse-once canonicalization, identifier and intent journaling, expected-head and expected-digest preconditions, signing, fast-forward publication, conflict classification, idempotent reconciliation, and receipts. Inference supplies semantic intent but cannot authorize, silently retry across target changes, or trigger readiness/work effects.
